definitions.isolated_run: The mutation is applied and every other isolation protection that could hide it is switched off (using lab switches), so only the mutated layer stands between tenants.
definitions.caught: A mutation is CAUGHT if the attack suite reports a leak in its ISOLATED run.
definitions.missed: A mutation is MISSED if the suite reports no leak in its ISOLATED run, meaning the attack suite cannot see that mistake.
definitions.masked_run: The same mutation with all other protections ON. Evaluates whether defense-in-depth layers masked the mistake. Informational and not part of the score.

isolation_mutation_score: 4 caught by the attack suite and 1 caught by a dedicated probe, out of 5
